card.name: The word documented in trial results
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "documented" right after had, with, or to in clinical trial reports of events. Weaker on similar reporting verbs such as observed, shows, and tested.

modes.label: documented
modes.description: The word "documented" modifies an event or outcome in adverse event or case descriptions.
modes.example: 10 patients (12%) had<< documented>> heart rates less than 60 bpm

modes.label: Reporting verbs
modes.description: Verbs like observed, shows, or tested that introduce a study finding or test.
modes.example: Table 4<< shows>> the proportions of patients with changes in fasting

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "documented" and similar reporting words when a trial describes what was found in patients.
